summary: To find where a specific module went, check runtime.yml (which lists the first destination of each extracted module), search Ansible Galaxy, or ask in the chat channels.
questions: Which collection contains the module I used in Ansible 2.9?
How do I find where a module moved to?

answer_card.title: Find which collection a module moved to
answer_card.answer_md: Check ansible-core's **`lib/ansible/config/ansible_builtin_runtime.yml`** (runtime.yml), which lists the first destination of every extracted module. Some moved again later, so also search **Ansible Galaxy** or ask in the community chat.
